_about: Photos on the trade pages' before/after sample (set 1, 'On the job', chosen from /prototypes/sample on seopage.com #39). Generated through api.esy.com's generate-photoreal-image; files in public/trade/<trade>/<key>.webp. The builder generates its own photos until customer uploads ship (api.esy.com #526).
artDirection: Documentary job-site photography for a local trade business. Natural overcast daylight, true-to-life color, candid and unposed, 35mm lens look. Workers in plain work clothes are seen from behind or at a distance, faces not the subject. Everyday American suburbs. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names on equipment.

hero.prompt: A two-story suburban home with a freshly replaced asphalt shingle roof, ladder against the gutter, clean ridge lines.
hero.altText: A worker in a hard hat climbs an extension ladder leaning against the gutter of a two-story suburban home with a dark asphalt shingle roof, with shingle debris scattered on the driveway and a calm overcast sky and dry lawn to the left.

storm.prompt: A roof being repaired after a hail storm: bruised shingles next to new ones, a blue tarp folded back, roofing nails and a hammer.
storm.altText: Close-up of an asphalt shingle roof under repair with weathered shingles beside newer sections, a folded-back blue tarp at left, scattered roofing nails with plastic caps, a chalk reel and a claw hammer in the foreground, and a worker kneeling in the blurred background over a suburban skyline.

replacement.prompt: A new standing-seam metal roof on a ranch-style house, a stack of leftover panels on the lawn.
replacement.altText: A ranch-style house with a new dark gray standing-seam metal roof, where a hard-hatted worker carries a panel toward a ladder while a stack of leftover roofing panels rests on the dry front lawn under overcast daylight.

leak.prompt: Attic underside of a roof with a water stain around a vent pipe, new flashing and a bucket below.
leak.altText: Interior attic view of a person in a black hoodie and gloves installing metal flashing around a metal vent pipe on water-stained wood sheathing, with a galvanized bucket on the plywood floor below and fiberglass insulation to the right.

hvac.context: Heating and air conditioning company in Phoenix, Arizona

hero.prompt: A new outdoor air conditioning condenser on a concrete pad beside a stucco desert home, a technician's tool bag next to it.
hero.altText: A new gray outdoor air conditioning condenser on a concrete pad beside a tan stucco desert home, with an open tool bag holding refrigerant gauges and copper tubing in front, and a technician crouched at the right working on the unit.

ac.prompt: An outdoor AC condenser with its service panel open, refrigerant hoses connected, tools on a towel.
ac.altText: An outdoor air conditioning condenser with its service panel open and a gloved technician's hand using a wrench inside, colored refrigerant hoses running to a manifold gauge set, with hand tools, a rag, and coiled wire laid out on a canvas drop cloth.

furnace.prompt: A gas furnace in a garage utility closet with its front panel off and a blue burner flame visible, a new air filter beside it.
furnace.altText: An open gas furnace in a garage utility closet with a lit blue burner row visible, a new pleated air filter and a dirty used filter standing on the concrete floor beside it, with a flashlight on the ground and a desert home visible through the open door.

replacement.prompt: A newly installed heat pump air handler in a tidy utility closet, protective plastic still on it, copper line set neatly insulated.
replacement.altText: A newly installed heat pump air handler still covered in factory protective plastic inside a residential utility closet, with insulated black-wrapped refrigerant lines and a bright copper pipe running to the unit, and a worker standing in a doorway with a coiled hose in the background.
